def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left=[row[:sep] for row in grid]; right=[row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    lb=Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rb=Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark=3
    return [[mark if left[r][c] != lb and right[r][c] == rb else rb for c in range(len(right[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
